name: Aaron Howearth
title: Clinical Psychologist (Registrar) & Director
description: Aaron identifies as a non-binary, gay man and has a lived experience of Social Anxiety Disorder and ADHD, giving him a special interest in supporting and affirming the queer and neurodiverse communities. Holds associate membership of the EMDR Association of Australia; practice offers queer-affirming therapy and WPATH assessments.
specialties: queer-affirming therapy, EMDR, neurodiversity, ADHD, eating disorders, WPATH assessments

name: Dani Croaker
title: Psychologist, MPsych (Ed&Dev)
description: Compassionate psychologist with lived experience in Autism and ADHD. Conducts WPATH Assessments and treats anxiety, depression, identity, relationships and self-esteem (practice is queer-affirming).
specialties: WPATH assessments, autism, ADHD, identity, neurodiversity

name: Gabriella Joustra
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: With lived experience with dyslexia, Gabriella is committed to neuro-affirming and queer-affirming practice. Trained in CBT and trauma-focussed CBT.
